exposure: Peak intensity ratios of caesarean scar to myometrium
cohort: Thirty patients in their first trimester of pregnancy, suspected of caesarean scar pregnancy by conventional ultrasound and insisting on abortions, were enrolled.
finding: CEUS offers good diagnostic performance for caesarean scar pregnancy, and the peak intensity ratio of caesarean scar to myometrium can be used as a quantitative index to diagnose CSP accurately.
